As we all know, they're scheduled to return next Monday, and I'm responsible for making the binding decision on their return plan. Before I can approve any plan, our re-entry policy requires me to gather current implementation information from classroom staff, counseling, and family-support staff. The plan also needs to address supervision during unstructured periods, daily check-ins, extracurricular participation, and communication with the student's caregiver. I'd like to hear from each of you on these areas so we can put together a comprehensive and supportive plan. Who would like to start?
